sessions.phase_label: Deliverable evaluation, rejection, and conditional remediation

requirements.title: Danish Voiceover Audit
requirements.definition: Review the supplied Danish voiceover by listening to it and marking identified errors, producing an actual audio audit rather than unrelated or AI-generated narrative content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the substantive auditory review and error findings. Placement of comments in the supplied audit format is independently correctable and remains a separate Requirement; proofreading of the source text is also separate.

requirements.title: Voiceover Audit Comment Placement
requirements.definition: Enter voiceover-audit comments in the middle section designated for comments in the supplied audit format.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a formatting and placement constraint that can be corrected without repeating the substantive audio review, so it is separate from audit-content accuracy.

requirements.title: Danish Text Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread and revise the Danish source text so it is accurate and suitable for producing the intended voiceover, with work acceptable as genuine review rather than unusable AI-produced text.
requirements.boundary_note: Text proofreading has its own disputed accuracy and acceptance trajectory and can succeed or fail independently of the resulting voiceover audit.
